actions.description:
Requirements The enormous dragonfly has a Large or smaller creature Grabbed in its mandibles

Effect The dragonfly tries to transfer the grabbed creature to be clutched by its legs. The enormous dragonfly attempts an @Check[athletics|defense:reflex] check against the creature's Reflex DC. On a success, it transfers the creature (which remains grabbed) to its legs, freeing its mandibles to attack. The dragonfly can have only one creature clutched at a time.
actions.name: Clutch
actions.requirements: The enormous dragonfly has a Large or smaller creature Grabbed in its mandibles

actions.description: The dragonfly Flies up to its Speed and makes one mandible Strike at any point during that movement.
actions.name: Swoop

actions.description: The enormous dragonfly can Fly at half Speed while it has a creature Grabbed or Restrained by Clutch, carrying that creature along with it.
actions.name: Snatch

name: Enormous Dragonfly
publicNotes: These buzzing insects are the size of a small horse. They are ambush predators known to hunt beasts and humanoids alike, capable of using impressive aerial acrobatics to swoop down from above and snatch away their prey.
